title: Bioactive metabolites from cultures of the entomopathogenic fungus Pleurocordyceps ophiocordycipiticola TBRC-BCC 9612
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3868-3879
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09809B, Paper
Open Access

Siriporn Saepua, Karoon Sadorn, Jittra Kornsakulkarn, Patchanee Auncharoen, Suchada Mongkolsamrit, Donnaya Thanakitpipattana, Chawanee Thongpanchang
Seven new metabolites were isolated from Pleurocordyceps ophiocordycipiticola. Structural elucidation and bioassays revealed ergot alkaloids and tetramic acid derivatives with antimalarial, antibacterial, antifungal, and cytotoxic activities.
